extract_video_frames: run the video to images tool to extract frames from a video file using ffmpeg
extract_frames_with_step: extract every nth frame from a video by setting the step parameter in the config
extract_frames_with_limit: extract a limited number of frames from a video by setting the limit parameter
extract_frames_with_skip: skip to a specific timestamp in a video before extracting frames using the skip parameter
extract_mask_images: extract frames from a video and convert them to single channel mask images using the mask flag
